en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a large formal city square with lawns, paths, and tall cypress trees. In the background on the right stands a long, neoclassical palace‑like building with many windows and a flag flying from the roof. To the left and center are other multi‑storey neoclassical buildings. In the foreground runs a street with a few pedestrians and ornate, arched street lamps lining the sidewalk. The image has an old, slightly faded print quality, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. A website watermark, 'www.elia.org.gr', is visible at the bottom right.
